name: legacy_monster_object_update
purpose: Walks legacy MOB lists, updates monster/object animation and movement state, and invokes the module's collision/path workers
arguments: object-list selector word
exceptional_convention: normal stack ABI; module has no Gauntlet II caller
reachability: No incoming transfer from active OS or supplied Gauntlet II main ROM

name: legacy_monster_choose_direction
purpose: Chooses a direction from nearby player positions, validates terrain interactions, and schedules the legacy move/path operation
arguments: D2.w object byte offset; inherited A2-A6 VRAM/state bases
return: updates object direction/path state; condition codes
reachability: No incoming transfer from active OS or supplied Gauntlet II main ROM

name: legacy_four_cell_occupied_test

arguments: D4.w first cell byte offset; inherited A2 and alternate occupancy base
return: condition codes from first clear/occupied result
reachability: No incoming transfer from active OS or supplied Gauntlet II main ROM

name: legacy_position_in_active_bounds

return: D4.l=-1 inside wrapped active window; 0 outside
reachability: No incoming transfer from active OS or supplied Gauntlet II main ROM

name: legacy_set_direction_from_delta

return: void; direction bits updated in A6[D2]
reachability: No incoming transfer from active OS or supplied Gauntlet II main ROM
